index.title: Expenses
index.subtitle: Fuel, tolls, lumper, advances. What a load cost beyond the rate — and who ends up paying it.
index.frozenWarning: This load is already invoiced or settled. Those figures are frozen, so approving this will not change them — you would need a credit or an adjustment.
index.rejectReason: Why is it rejected? The person who submitted it will read this.

form.title: New expense
form.subtitle: An expense belongs to a load. Until someone approves it, it moves no money.
form.loadHint: Type three characters of the load number.
form.frozenWarning: This load is already invoiced or settled. Its figures are frozen: an expense added now will not appear on those documents.
form.incurredHint: When the money was spent, not today.
form.descriptionHint: Where, what for, receipt number. Whoever reviews it only sees what you write here.
form.approvalNote: Submitting does not approve it. Someone with approval rights has to review it before it counts on an invoice or a settlement.

treatmentHelp.excluded_from_commission: The money passed through us but is not ours to take a fee on: it comes out of the commission base.
treatmentHelp.reimbursable_to_carrier: The carrier fronted it and gets it back. It raises the settlement.
treatmentHelp.tenant_absorbed: We pay it and do not pass it on. It lowers our margin.
treatmentHelp.carrier_deduction: It is held back from the carrier. It lowers the settlement.

errors.loadNotFound: That load does not exist or is not yours.
errors.categoryNotFound: That category does not exist or is no longer active.
errors.badTransition: That expense is no longer in a state where this can be done. Reload the page.

flash.submitted: Expense submitted. It counts once someone approves it.
flash.decidedButFrozen: Expense updated. Its load is already invoiced or settled, so those frozen figures did not change.
